title: 先進プログラミング応用
subtitle: Advanced Programming Applications
keywords: Data analysis 2.Machine learning 3.Agile development method 4.Data visualization 5.Python
educationalGoal: This course is designed to achieve the learning and education goal of the information design fundamentals in the Department of Management Information. Students take big data analysis as a realistic system and use Python to perform analysis such as data visualization, classification, identification, regression, prediction, and clustering. The goal is to acquire the basic skills of system development.
advice: Participate in the data analysis competition platform "Kaggle", create highly accurate machine learning models, and aim to rank up through analysis of given data, algorithm selection, training data preprocessing and learning, and improving Python programming. By competing with data scientists around the world, students aim to acquire more practical advanced programming development capabilities. For the students who do not have sufficient knowledge to create machine learning models, it will be difficult to keep up with the lessons, so be careful when choosing this course.
requiredKnowledge: Must have basic knowledge of Python programming. Moreover, should have the following knowledge: - Data analyzing knowledge to organize the data into appropriate tables or graphs and evaluate using representative values of distributions and correlation coefficients. - Machine learning knowledge to generate learning data by appropriately separating objective variables and explanatory variables.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain agile development method.
Be able to implement basic techniques for data analysis using Python.
Be able to access the time series database.
Be able to explain the developed system in an easy-to-understand manner.
